oliver: Deploybot blocked rc-3310 canary: arm64 SBOM hash mismatch + one transitive medium CVE flagged in build metadata. Change window ends in ~5h. Options: regional carveout (APAC), pin arm64 to rc-3305, or hold full rollout. @jin @security/legal

deploybot: [automated] scan result: status=blocked release=rc-3310 details={arm64: sbom_hash!=registry, cve_list:[CVE-2026-1234]}

jin: Quick triage: CVE comes from a debug-only dependency, low runtime exposure. SBOM hash mismatch suggests an indexing glitch or a rebuild race. Prefer carveout for APAC arm64 and continue amd64 canary.

security: Approve temporary regional carveout if we add controls: edge sampling of 100% arm64 requests, stricter circuit breaker (fail fast), and auto-fallback to rc-3305 for any arm64 error spike. Also require a signed SBOM within 6h.

legal: We'll require a short release note entry noting the carveout and that full production rollout will be blocked until SBOM reconciled. Wording approved if security confirms controls.

oliver: Plan: 1) Apply routing exclude for arm64 in ap-southeast now. 2) Start amd64-only canary. 3) Timebox 6h for rebuild and signed SBOM. 4) If unresolved, pin arm64 to rc-3305.

deploybot: [automated] routing exclude requested for region=ap-southeast arch=arm64 by oliver at 4987654380

deploybot: [automated] canary start: rc-3310 (amd64-only) -> global-canary at 4987654440 rollout_id=r-ab12

jin: Creating alert vuln_arm64_rc_3310 to notify #security and oncall if any arm64 traffic observed or CVE pattern appears.

legal: Release note published: https://docs.internal/releases/rc-3310-notes "Arm64 variant excluded from APAC canary due to SBOM hash mismatch and a transitive CVE flag. Affected variant will remain excluded until artifact verification."

oliver: Timebox set to 6h (deadline 4987677940). Reopen thread if SBOM appears or if alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
